ModMetaData.name: No Lightning Fires
ModMetaData.author: Xmaxer
ModMetaData.description:
Lightning no longer starts fires.
A strike still hits with the same bolt, flash, thunder and burn damage. Pawns and buildings it hits are still hurt, but nothing catches fire. This covers thunderstorms, dry thunderstorms and flashstorms.
There are no settings. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
Requires Harmony.
